Speed v = 0.96 c  ⇒  β = 0.96  
Lorentz factor γ = 1/√(1–β²) = 1/√(1–0.96²) = 1/√0.0784 = 1/0.28 ≈ 3.5714

Nucleus X : ³Li with 3 neutrons → ⁶Li (Z = 3, A = 6)  
Mass of ⁶Li atom: 6.0151228 u  
Subtract 3 electron masses (3×0.00054858 u) to get nuclear mass:

mₙᵤc ≈ 6.0151228 u – 0.0016457 u = 6.0134771 u

1 u = 931.494 MeV/c², so

mₙᵤc c² ≈ 6.0134771 × 931.494 MeV ≈ 5.60 GeV

Total relativistic energy of the nucleus:

E = γ m c² ≈ 3.5714 × 5.60 GeV ≈ 20.0 GeV

Among the given choices, 20.132 GeV is the only value consistent with this result. (Note: this is the energy of one ⁶Li nucleus; do not double it.)
